page.overview:
Who is Darko Draganov?

Darko Draganov was a host of the Communinet Radio station of House Harkonnen.

Darko Draganov began his show with the segment "Whispers & Rumors", in which he described reports of vandalism of property of House Harkonnen, promising a fine meal with a Harkonnen official to the first twenty listeners to come forward with the names of culprits. In the segment "Voice of the People", he read a message from Kamelia, who asked how often one should submit a report to the Dune Watch network, to which he advised her to submit a report on a daily basis. In the segment "Baron's Most Wanted", he described Zantara's use of atomics to sunder the Shield Wall, informing his listeners of the one million solari bounty that the Imperium had placed and another million that House Harkonnen was offering for his crysknife. In "Hero of the Day", Draganov told the story of Micah, a seven-year-old boy who reported his own parents to Dune Watch for allowing him to listen to an opera on the Battle of Corrin, which slandered Bashar Abulurd Harkonnen. His parents were detained indefinitely and his future was uncertain, but he would be rewarded by getting to watch the gladiator games in Baron Vladimir Harkonnen's private box.
